name: Extruct AI
summary: Company search by natural-language description, lookalikes of a reference company, company profiles, and async Deep Search and Deep Research tasks.

api_token.description: An Extruct API token (app.extruct.ai/api-tokens), sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Search and lookalike return at most 250 results a call; page with pagination.offset. Paid plans reach 2,000 results per query, the free tier 25.
Deep Search and Deep Research are async: create the task, poll GET by id until status is done (or is_exhausted for Deep Search), then read results.
Company lookup costs 0 credits; Deep Research bills 2 credits per research agent that runs and reserves the depth's full budget at start.
Table (enrichment) endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search companies by description
endpoints.summary: Companies matching a natural-language query, ranked, with descriptions, firmographics, HQ and relevance score.

filters.description: SearchFilters object: include/exclude {size, country, city} (exclude also takes domains, up to 1000), range {founded: {min, max}}. Size buckets: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, 10001+.

notes: A read over POST (the GET variant takes filters as a URL-encoded string).

endpoints.name: Find similar companies
endpoints.summary: Companies most like a reference company, ranked on what they do, who they sell to, firmographics and traffic.

company_identifier.description: Reference company domain or Extruct UUID.

filters.description: SearchFilters object: include/exclude {size, country, city} (exclude also takes domains, up to 1000), range {founded: {min, max}}. Size buckets: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-500, 501-1000, 1001-5000, 5001-10000, 10001+.

notes: A read over POST. The reference company is excluded from its own results; 404 when it is not in the index.

endpoints.name: Look up a company profile
endpoints.summary: The full Extruct profile for a domain or UUID: descriptions, products, use cases, audience, firmographics, socials and sources.
notes: 202 with status enriching means the profile is being built; retry the same call later. 0 credits.

endpoints.name: Start a Deep Search task
endpoints.summary: Agentic company discovery for a described profile, each result graded 1-5 against criteria.

query.description: Natural-language description of the companies to find.

criteria.description: Criterion definitions to grade results on; inferred from the query when omitted.

exclude_domains.description: Domains or URLs to keep out of results.

exclude_task_ids.description: Up to 100 ids of finished Deep Search tasks whose results to exclude.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
Returns a task id immediately; spends credits as it runs.

endpoints.name: Get a Deep Search task
endpoints.summary: Task status and counts (discovered, enriched, evaluated, results).
notes: Done when status is done or is_exhausted is true.

endpoints.name: Get Deep Search results
endpoints.summary: Companies found, ordered by relevance, with per-criterion scores and explanations.
notes: Page until a page returns fewer rows than limit.

endpoints.name: Start a Deep Research task
endpoints.summary: A cited research report on a company, person or team from a written brief, as markdown or to a JSON Schema.

brief.description: Research brief, up to 20,000 characters: the targets, your context and the decision it supports.

depth.description: Agent budget: medium (5), high (15), xhigh (25). Default medium.

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema object for a structured report; omit for markdown.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
Pro plan only. 2 credits per research agent that runs; the depth's full budget (10/30/50) must be available. Failed tasks are refunded.

endpoints.name: Get a Deep Research task
endpoints.summary: Status and, when done, the report.
notes: Poll until status is done or failed; failure_reason explains a rejected brief.
